mapper.select: SELECT sm.sys_menu_perm FROM sys_menu sm LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm ON sm.sys_menu_id = srm.sys_menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.sys_role_id = srm.sys_role_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sur.sys_role_id = sr.sys_role_id WHERE sm.sys_menu_type = 3 AND sur.sys_user_id = #{userId} AND sm.sys_menu_perm IS NOT NULL

SELECT sr.sys_role_id, sr.sys_role_name, sr.sys_role_code, sr.sys_role_readable, sr.sys_role_writeable, sr.sys_role_executable, sm.sys_menu_perm, sd.sys_dept_data_permission, sd.sys_dept_data_permission_dept_id FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.sys_dept_id = su.sys_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sur.sys_user_id = su.sys_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.sys_role_id = sur.sys_role_id AND sr.sys_role_status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm ON srm.sys_role_id = sr.sys_role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu sm ON sm.sys_menu_id = srm.sys_menu_id AND sm.sys_menu_type = 3 AND sm.sys_menu_perm IS NOT NULL WHERE su.sys_user_id = #{userId}

SELECT MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', COALESCE(CAST(su.sys_user_id AS CHAR), ''), COALESCE(su.sys_user_username, ''), COALESCE(su.sys_user_nickname, ''), COALESCE(su.sys_user_phone, ''), COALESCE(CAST(su.sys_user_status AS CHAR), ''), COALESCE(CAST(su.sys_dept_id AS CHAR), ''), COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(su.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ''), COALESCE(CAST(sd.sys_dept_data_permission AS CHAR), ''), COALESCE(sd.sys_dept_data_permission_dept_id, ''), COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(sd.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ''), COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(':', sur.sys_role_id, COALESCE(sr.sys_role_code, ''), COALESCE(CAST(sr.sys_role_status AS CHAR), ''), COALESCE(CAST(sr.sys_role_readable AS CHAR), ''), COALESCE(CAST(sr.sys_role_writeable AS CHAR), ''), COALESCE(CAST(sr.sys_role_executable AS CHAR), ''), COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(sr.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '') ) ORDER BY sur.sys_role_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role sur LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.sys_role_id = sur.sys_role_id WHERE sur.sys_user_id = su.sys_user_id ), ''), COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(':', srm.sys_role_id, srm.sys_menu_id, COALESCE(sm.sys_menu_perm, ''), COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(sm.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '') ) ORDER BY srm.sys_role_id, srm.sys_menu_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_role_menu srm LEFT JOIN sys_menu sm ON sm.sys_menu_id = srm.sys_menu_id AND sm.sys_menu_type = 3 WHERE srm.sys_role_id IN ( SELECT sur2.sys_role_id FROM sys_user_role sur2 WHERE sur2.sys_user_id = su.sys_user_id ) ), ''), COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(':', rel.sys_dept_id, COALESCE(sd2.sys_dept_tree_id, ''), COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(sd2.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '') ) ORDER BY rel.sys_dept_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_dept_principal_rel rel LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd2 ON sd2.sys_dept_id = rel.sys_dept_id WHERE rel.sys_user_id = su.sys_user_id ), '') )) FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.sys_dept_id = su.sys_dept_id WHERE su.sys_user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT su.*, sug.copms_list FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_user_grid sug ON sug.user_id = su.sys_user_id WHERE su.sys_user_username = #{accessKey}

SELECT u.*, t.sys_tenant_id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON u.sys_tenant_id = t.sys_tenant_id WHERE (u.sys_user_username = #{username} OR u.sys_user_phone = #{username})
AND t.sys_tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( sys_user_username, sys_user_salt, sys_user_password, sys_user_in_system, sys_user_status, sys_user_phone, sys_tenant_id) VALUES ( #{sysUser.sysUserUsername}, #{sysUser.sysUserSalt}, #{sysUser.sysUserPassword}, #{sysUser.sysUserInSystem}, #{sysUser.sysUserStatus}, #{sysUser.sysUserPhone}, #{tenant.sysTenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT t.sys_tenant_code FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON u.sys_tenant_id = t.sys_tenant_id WHERE (u.sys_user_username = #{username} OR u.sys_user_phone = #{username}) AND t.sys_tenant_status = 0 AND t.sys_tenant_delete = 0 ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
